content.value_statement: Market research often requires several disconnected screens, data checks, and analytical frameworks. This skill organizes Longbridge data into focused market intelligence reports.
actual_capabilities: Runs documented Longbridge workflows for screeners, rankings, movers, anomalies, and index or ETF constituents.
Creates morning briefs and catalyst reports from quotes, news, filings, calendars, and capital-flow data.
Evaluates ETFs using tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, holdings, and allocation fit.
Assesses sector rotation, market microstructure, event reactions, and supply-chain relationships.
Builds industry overviews and disruptive-innovation scenarios with explicit assumptions and risk notes.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or MCP access and current network availability.
Some workflows may require updated command flags or authentication, despite the public-command claim.
Results depend on available market data and may omit unavailable fields or delayed information.
Outputs are informational research and do not constitute personalized investment advice.

use_cases.title: Scan Daily Market Activity
use_cases.description: Review movers, anomalies, popularity rankings, and related news before a trading session.

use_cases.title: Compare Funds and Sectors
use_cases.description: Evaluate ETF structure, liquidity, holdings overlap, sector momentum, valuation, and capital flows.

use_cases.title: Research Events and Themes
use_cases.description: Build structured reports on corporate events, industries, supply chains, and disruptive innovation.

prompt_templates.title: Review Top Movers
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top 10 US market movers today, connect each move to available news, and note missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Stock Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Screen Hong Kong stocks for positive return on equity and moderate valuation, then explain each filter and summarize the strongest matches.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two ETFs
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare SPY.US and QQQ.US across tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, holdings overlap, and currency exposure.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rotation Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a US sector rotation report using 20-day, 60-day, and 120-day momentum, capital flows, valuation, and economic-cycle context.

output_examples.input: Find notable US market movers and explain the likely drivers.
output: Market movers are ranked by abnormal price movement.
Each entry includes available news context, timing, and evidence gaps.
The report separates technical anomalies from news-supported explanations.

output_examples.input: Analyze SPY.US as a portfolio holding.
output: The report covers product profile, tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, and key holdings.
Unavailable expense or NAV data is labeled clearly.
The conclusion states allocation characteristics without issuing personalized advice.

output_examples.input: Assess semiconductor sector rotation in the United States.
output: Sector proxies are compared across short, medium, and long momentum windows.
Capital flow and valuation provide confirmation or contradiction.
The final view identifies cycle context, catalysts, risks, and data limitations.

best_practices: Specify the market, symbols, comparison universe, and analysis horizon.
Verify current Longbridge flags with command help before requesting data.
Require source labels, timestamps, missing-data notes, and an investment-risk disclaimer.
anti_patterns: Do not infer an ambiguous ticker, exchange, benchmark, or sector universe.
Do not fabricate live values, unavailable fields, news causes, or historical reactions.
Do not treat rankings, sentiment, or scenario targets as personalized trading instructions.

faq.question: Which markets does this skill cover?
faq.answer: The documented workflows cover United States, Hong Kong, mainland China, and Singapore markets, with feature availability varying by command.

faq.question: Does the skill require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: The main skill declares public CLI access, but several reference workflows include authentication guidance for unavailable or restricted data.

faq.question: Can it screen stocks with custom criteria?
faq.answer: Yes. It can discover available screener indicators, apply value ranges, run saved strategies, and summarize matching securities.

faq.question: Can it compare ETFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare tracking error, liquidity, premium or discount, constituent overlap, market exposure, and available product details.

faq.question: Does it provide real-time investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It organizes available market data into informational research and should not replace independent financial judgment.

faq.question: What happens when Longbridge data is unavailable?
faq.answer: The workflows report missing fields, may use MCP fallback, and should avoid silent retries or unsupported estimates.
